title: GET /api/v1/team
description: Team v1 (15-teams): the owner row, active members and live invites, the caller's role, the shared-memory flag, the tenant's 30d TVO summary (aggregate; null when the report refuses), and placeholders that are null until their feature lands.

id.description: GET /me user.id for a member (the token sub), or invite:<uuid>

name.description: no users table: null until one lands

email.description: the address from the member's user token at accept (owner: at their last read/invite), or the invited address; null when none

last_active.description: latest device heartbeat of that member in this tenant; null for invites and members with no device yet

invite_link.description: the raw token is answered once by POST /team/invites; m1_081 keeps only its hash

fleet_status.description: enterprise fleet/gateway status: null until it exists
